description.value: Brassneck Brewery is a well-established craft brewery and tasting room on Main Street in Vancouver, known for a rotating roster of adventurous beers ranging from tart barrel-aged fruit ales to imperial milkshake stouts. The on-site tasting room pours a wide selection on tap and sells cans to go, with food available from sister restaurant The Magnet. Growler fills are offered for 0.5L, 1L, and 2L vessels, including those from other breweries.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 13m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 46m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 85m. Total: 11 spaces.
